description: This file defines a React hook `useProgressiveExpand` and a utility function `createProgressiveExpandController` that facilitate batch processing of items in a non-blocking, incremental manner. It allows UI components to initiate, monitor, and cancel progressive work, such as expanding tree nodes, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallback.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages progressive batch processing of items, with support for cancelation and progress callbacks.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller to provide component-friendly state management for progressive processing.
